title: CLCON/131/2016 of Sayad Rafat Ali Vs Pankaj Upadhyaya

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT
NAINITAL
Civil Contempt Petition (CLCON) No. 131 of 2016
(Under Article 226 of the Constitution of India)
Sayad Rafat Ali .......... Applicant

Mr. Ganesh Kandpal, Advocate for the applicant.
Mr. Sarvesh Agarwal, Advocate along with Mr. Pankaj Miglani,
Advocate for the opposite party.
U.C. Dhyani, J. (Oral)

MCC No. 275/2016 (Recall Application), CLMA No.
4052/2016 (Intervention Application) and CLMA No.
4162/2016 (Miscellaneous Application) are taken up for
decision in civil contempt no. 131/2016.
2. On 26.2.2016, an order was passed by this Court in
WPMS no. 445/2016 'Sayad Rafat Ali vs. District Magistrate,
Nainital' as below:
"The innocuous prayer made by learned counsel for the
petitioner is allowed. And endeavour shall be made by the respondent
authority to decide the representation of the petitioner by a reasoned
and speaking order within a period of four weeks from the date of
production of a certified copy of this order along with a copy of the
representation."
3. When learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that
the order dated 26.02.2016 (Supra) has not been complied with,
this Court passed the following order on 21.4.2016 in civil
contempt petition no. 131 of 2016:

"This Court, instead of issuing notice to the
respondent/opposite party, reiterates the order dated 26.02.2016,
passed by this Court and directs the authority concerned to consider
the representation of the petitioner, failing which he will be liable to
face appropriate action under the Contempt of Courts Act.
Petitioner is directed to place a copy of this order, as also
the order dated 26.02.2016 to remind the respondent that a duty is
cast upon him to do something, which has not been done.
With the observation as above, the contempt petition stands
disposed of."
4. Learned counsel for recall-applicant seeks to recall the
order dated 21.4.2016 on the ground, interalia, that the order
dated 26.02.2016 was already complied with by the opposite
party, which fact is evident from a perusal of Annexure-10 in
writ petition no. WPMS no. 728/2016. This Court was therefore,
taken through the order dated 17.3.2016 passed by the Addl.
Waqf Commissioner/SDM, Haldwani.
5. Any person can be hauled up in contempt only when there
is willful disobedience of any judgment, direction, decree, writ or
any other order of any Court. In the instant case, the order was
already passed by the opposite party on 17.3.2016, which is
Annexure-10 to the writ petition no. 728 of 2016.
6. Even if assuming that Annexure-10 is not in the desired
format, as argued by the learned counsel for the petitioner in
contempt petition, the fact remains, as is evident on a perusal of
the record, that there was no willful disobedience of the order of
the Court on the part of opposite party, and therefore, application
filed by the recall-applicant deserves to be allowed.
7. In order to fulfill the contempt requirements, the applicant
is required to prove, on the basis of documents or otherwise, that
the alleged contemnor not only violated the Court's order, but
also that such violation was willful.
8. Recall application being MCC no. 275/2016 is, therefore,
allowed, and as a consequence thereof, order dated 21.4.2016 is
recalled in the interest of justice.
2

9. Contempt petition stands dismissed.
10. Since the recall applicant was permitted to intervene and
heard in the interest of justice, therefore, such application, being
CLMA no. 4052/2016, stands allowed.
11. Yet another miscellaneous application, being CLMA no.
4162/2016, has been filed on behalf of the intervener to initiate
action under Section 340 Cr.P.C. against the contempt petitioner.
12. In the given circumstances of the case, which have been
referred to herein above, the Court does not find it expedient, in
the interest of justice, that any enquiry should be made into the
offence, alleged to have been committed by the petitioner, in the
intervener's application no. 4162/2016. CLMA no. 4162/2016
therefore, also stands disposed of.
